title: Design System: Sri Lanka Travel Mobility Review Artifact

label.purpose: Frame IDs, references, times, state codes, indices, and annotation keys.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: High-emphasis review action with square geometry and reversible black-and-white hover state.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; color: var(--paper, #fff); background: var(--ink, #111); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); border-radius: 0; font: 700 1rem/1.55 "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { color: var(--ink, #111); background: var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #111); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined paper action for secondary choices and recovery paths.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 2.75rem; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: .5rem; padding: .65rem 1rem; color: var(--ink, #111); background: var(--paper, #fff); border: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); border-radius: 0; font: 700 1rem/1.55 "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--paper-mid, #e3e3e3); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #111); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Review Field
components.description: Square ruled field for schematic form studies.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: var(--ink, #111); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field > span { display: block; margin-bottom: .25rem; font-size: .8rem; font-weight: 750; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.6rem; padding: .55rem .65rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #4b4b4b); background: var(--paper, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #181818); border-radius: 0; font: .8125rem/1.55 inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--focus, #111); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: State Tag
components.description: Text-first operational state with a double rule as a redundant cue.
components.css: .ds-state-tag { display: inline-block; padding: .12rem .35rem; color: var(--ink, #111); background: var(--paper, #fff); border: 3px double var(--rule, #181818); border-radius: 0; font: 700 .8125rem/1.4 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Review Rail Link
components.description: Indexed navigation row from the persistent black review rail.
components.css: .ds-rail-link { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.2rem 1fr; padding: .55rem 0; color: #efefef; background: var(--ink, #111); border-bottom: 1px solid #3f3f3f; font: .86rem/1.55 "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-rail-link > span { font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-rail-link:hover { padding-inline: .5rem; color: var(--ink, #111); background: var(--paper, #fff); } .ds-rail-link:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--paper, #fff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-review-frame { color: var(--ink, #111); font-family: "Avenir Next", Avenir, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-review-frame > header { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: .75rem; margin-bottom: .5rem; font: .8rem/1.4 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-review-frame > header span:last-child { color: var(--ink-soft, #4b4b4b); text-align: right; } .ds-review-canvas { min-height: 8rem; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: .5rem; background: var(--paper, #fff); border: .5rem solid var(--paper-soft, #f3f3f3); outline: 2px solid var(--rule, #181818); font: .8125rem/1.4 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; } .ds-review-frame > p { margin: .75rem 0 0; padding: .75rem; background: var(--paper-mid, #e3e3e3); border-top: 2px solid var(--rule, #181818); font-size: .8rem; } .ds-review-frame > p strong { font-family: SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; }

components.name: Client Asset Placeholder
components.description: Skeletal field that reserves space while naming the missing evidence owner.
components.css: .ds-asset-placeholder { min-height: 7rem; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: .75rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #4b4b4b); background: var(--paper-soft, #f3f3f3); border: 1px dashed var(--rule, #181818); border-radius: 0; font: .8125rem/1.4 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Fleet Schedule State
components.description: A compact sample of confirmed, pending, hold, maintenance, and buffer line grammar.
components.css: .ds-schedule { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(6rem, 1fr)); gap: .5rem; color: var(--ink, #111); font: .75rem/1.2 SFMono-Regular, Consolas, "Liberation Mono", monospace; } .ds-schedule span { min-height: 2.3rem; display: grid; place-items: center; padding: .25rem; background: var(--paper, #fff); border: 2px solid var(--rule, #181818); text-align: center; } .ds-schedule .ds-pending { border-style: dashed; } .ds-schedule .ds-hold { border-style: dotted; } .ds-schedule .ds-maintenance { background: var(--paper-mid, #e3e3e3); border-style: double; border-width: 3px; } .ds-schedule .ds-buffer { color: var(--ink-soft, #4b4b4b); border-width: 1px; }

narrative.overview:
This system documents a deliberately low-fidelity, code-led client-review artifact. It feels like a working transport-operations document: paper-white planes, graphite text, hard rules, compact identifiers, and inspectable screen frames. Its authority comes from explicit structure and evidence, not polish. The visual language helps stakeholders approve workflows while continuously signaling that branding, commercial values, real fleet content, production components, and final implementation remain unresolved.

This is not the future customer-facing identity and must not be treated as a production UI design system. It may guide extensions to this review walkthrough and related planning artifacts only. The shipped surface rejects glossy travel imagery, gradients, soft cards, floating pills, decorative icons, and brand color because those devices could make placeholders appear approved.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral grayscale surfaces with black, gray, and white carrying every distinction.
Square ruled frames, dense annotation, and visible document numbering.
Humanist sans-serif reading text paired with monospaced identifiers and operational data.
Responsive studies that preserve meaning by reflowing, stacking, or switching representation.
Placeholders that announce missing evidence instead of simulating final content.
A unified five-vehicle schedule whose line styles encode operational state without color.

rules.name: The Grayscale Evidence Rule
rules.body: Use only the documented achromatic tokens; distinction comes from label, weight, fill, and line pattern, never hue alone.

rules.name: The Approval Boundary Rule
rules.body: Do not introduce brand color, photography, decorative imagery, or polished marketing effects into this review system; they would imply decisions the client has not supplied.

rules.name: The Data Voice Rule
rules.body: Use the mono stack for identifiers, state codes, references, times, numeric indices, and annotations—not for ordinary paragraphs.

rules.name: The Scale-Not-Color Rule
rules.body: Establish reading hierarchy with type size, weight, spacing, and rules before considering fill reversal.

rules.name: The Representation-Change Rule
rules.body: When a desktop mechanism cannot remain legible, preserve its facts and decisions in a mobile-native representation rather than shrinking it.

rules.name: The Ruled-Plane Rule
rules.body: Separate levels with background tone and explicit rules; never add drop shadows to these review artifacts.

rules.name: The Square Frame Rule
rules.body: Keep structural containers and controls square; do not soften the planning artifact into rounded product cards or pills.

rules.name: The Line Carries Meaning Rule
rules.body: Preserve established solid, dashed, dotted, and double patterns whenever the corresponding state is shown, and pair every pattern with text.

dos: Do keep extensions neutral, square, ruled, and visibly low fidelity.
Do label every status in text and use fill or line pattern only as a redundant cue.
Do preserve real responsive behavior: stack, reflow, scroll, or change representation according to the shipped breakpoints.
Do mark unresolved assets and values with dashed skeletal fields, explicit ownership, and bracketed placeholders.
Do keep the five exact vehicles, their driver relationship, blocking windows, and conflicts visible in schedule studies.
Do preserve keyboard focus, skip navigation, reduced-motion behavior, adequate control height, and print-safe section framing.
donts: Don't treat this artifact as final brand guidance or reuse its wireframe components as production implementation decisions.
Don't invent a product name, logo, commercial value, rate, policy, claim, review, vehicle fact, provider, or image.
Don't add brand color, gradients, shadows, decorative imagery, floating pills, or rounded cards to make the artifact feel finished.
Don't encode status through color, gray tone, or border pattern alone.
Don't squeeze the desktop fleet timeline into a narrow viewport; use the shipped agenda representation.
Don't replace explicit placeholders with plausible-looking content before verified client evidence exists.
